limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the duty cycle but made the divide-by-7 output rise on the first input rising edge after reset release, rather than on the falling edge after the third rising edge as in the one-line AND-to-OR fix.
The test used the first output rise as its starting point and checked only subsequent pulse widths and reset levels, so it passed without detecting the changed output phase.
